categories.title: Top sights and day trips
categories.subtitle: Brisbane favourites and easy day trips

items.name: South Bank Parklands
items.summary: Riverside parklands with gardens, the Wheel of Brisbane, restaurants and the free Streets Beach lagoon.
items.why: A whole day out in one spot, right across the river from the city.
items.distance: About 5 km, 12 min drive or bus

items.name: Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary
items.summary: The world's first and largest koala sanctuary, with kangaroos to hand feed and native wildlife shows.
items.why: Getting up close to koalas and feeding kangaroos.

items.name: Mt Coot-tha Lookout
items.summary: A summit lookout with sweeping views over the city to Moreton Bay, plus a cafe and walking trails.
items.why: The best city view in Brisbane, especially at sunset.

items.name: Story Bridge Adventure Climb
items.summary: A guided climb to the top of Brisbane's famous cantilever bridge.
items.why: Huge 360 degree views and a real sense of adventure.
items.hours: Day, dawn, twilight and night climbs, book ahead

items.name: Kangaroo Point Cliffs
items.summary: Riverside cliffs with a lookout, picnic areas and outdoor rock climbing and abseiling.
items.why: Postcard city skyline views day and night.

items.name: Howard Smith Wharves
items.summary: A riverside dining and drinks precinct under the Story Bridge.
items.why: Waterfront restaurants, bars and a buzzing atmosphere.
items.distance: About 6 km, 15 min drive or ferry

items.name: Roma Street Parkland
items.summary: A large subtropical garden in the city with lakes, walks and playgrounds.
items.why: Peaceful green escape right in the CBD.
items.hours: Open 24 hours, Spectacle Garden and Rainforest Walk dawn to dusk

items.name: City Botanic Gardens
items.summary: Heritage riverside gardens next to the CBD with bamboo groves, lawns and fig trees.
items.why: Lovely shady walks along the river.

items.name: QAGOMA (Queensland Art Gallery and Gallery of Modern Art)
items.summary: Two of Australia's leading art galleries at the Cultural Centre.
items.why: World class exhibitions and free general entry.
items.distance: About 6 km, 15 min drive or bus

items.name: Queensland Museum Kurilpa
items.summary: The state museum covering natural history, dinosaurs and Queensland culture.
items.why: Great for families and rainy days.
items.distance: About 6 km, 15 min drive or bus

items.name: Moreton Island (Mulgumpin)
items.summary: A sand island in Moreton Bay with the Tangalooma wrecks, dunes and clear water.
items.why: Snorkelling the wrecks and sand tobogganing.

items.name: North Stradbroke Island (Minjerribah)
items.summary: A relaxed island with surf beaches, the North Gorge Walk and wildlife.
items.why: Spotting dolphins, turtles and whales from the gorge walk.
items.distance: About 30 min drive to Cleveland, then ferry

items.name: Gold Coast
items.summary: Famous surf beaches, Surfers Paradise and the hinterland.
items.why: Iconic beaches about an hour away.
items.distance: About 75 km, 1 hour drive or train

items.name: Sunshine Coast
items.summary: Relaxed beach towns like Noosa and Mooloolaba with national park walks.
items.why: Beautiful beaches and a slower pace.

items.name: Australia Zoo
items.summary: The zoo made famous by Steve Irwin, with crocodile shows and native animals.
items.why: The Crocoseum wildlife shows.

items.name: Dreamworld
items.summary: One of Australia's biggest theme parks, with thrill rides and Australian wildlife.
items.why: Big thrill rides plus native animals in one park.

items.name: Springbrook National Park
items.summary: Rainforest, waterfalls and the Natural Bridge glow worm cave.
items.why: Glow worms at night and stunning waterfalls.

items.name: Tamborine Mountain
items.summary: Rainforest village with the Skywalk, galleries, wineries and cafes.
items.why: Rainforest walks plus wine and cheese tastings.

categories.title: Markets

items.summary: Brisbane's best known farmers market beside the Brisbane Powerhouse.

items.summary: Local designers, artists and makers on Little Stanley Street.
items.why: Unique handmade gifts and souvenirs.

items.why: Relaxed Sunday stroll by the river.

items.summary: Brisbane's long running organic market at Northey Street City Farm.
items.why: Certified organic produce in a community farm setting.

items.name: Jan Powers Farmers Market, Manly
items.summary: Farmers market on the Manly waterfront.
items.why: Bayside setting with fresh produce.

items.name: Carseldine Farmers and Artisan Markets
items.summary: Produce and artisan market in Brisbane's north.
items.why: Lots of local growers and food.

items.name: Saturday Fresh Market, Rocklea
items.summary: Brisbane's largest food, plant and lifestyle market under the big roof at the Brisbane Markets.
items.why: Huge range of fresh produce, flowers, baked goods and meats.

items.summary: Premium food and farm fresh market on Milton Green with live entertainment.
items.why: Gourmet food plus kids' activities.

items.name: Nundah Farmers Markets
items.summary: Sunday market with fresh produce, gourmet meats, seafood, spices and coffee.
items.why: Relaxed local Sunday morning vibe.

items.why: Easy Saturday shop with local growers.

items.hours: Select Fridays 4pm to 9pm (23 Oct, 13 Nov, 18 Dec 2026)

items.name: Jan Powers Farmers Market, Mitchelton

items.why: Fresh produce and local food stalls.
items.hours: First Sunday of the month 6am to 12pm
